engine_source_policy: No src/rust/crates changes relative to engine_source_sha; measurement harness changes are bound by runner digest

corpus.description: 32 fixed doc rows and one canonical graph source with two derived claims and a supported edge

order: path order in workload source; query order alternates in successive repetitions
cache: warm read cache in one process; new temporary database for every mutating sample
concurrency: one foreground caller, background projection workers at the accepted 2/5 defaults
region: single engine call except projection write-to-ready and bounded model compatibility; setup, semantic validation, and close are outside the timed region except the named open/close cells
percentiles: nearest rank on sorted raw nanoseconds; p50, p90, p99, maximum
attribution: transparent provider elapsed/count where available; independently sampled gdb stacks for remaining paths; no setup time counted as an internal stage
deep_profile_selection: two highest valid non-model p90 paths, tie broken by path order; also graph_evidence
decision_rule: Existing gates remain separate; comparable breach blocks; exploratory hotspot receives owner follow-up; no tuning from one sample
gpu_policy: CPU default-model cell is small compatibility/repeatability probe only; substantial model embedding needs verified RTX 3090 CUDA engagement and a separate receipt
